They say no test of local optimality was run and no optimality is claimed. It asks for credit to Joost de Winter, Delft University of Technology, the slices coming from packings by Ostashev (129) and PingYou Ltd (153, 302) through the compilations of Prabhat, Malyshev and Couzo.
